claims.statement: OpenWiki quickstart is the wiki entry point and routes readers to the architecture, domain, workflows, operations, integrations, and testing pages based on change intent.
The quickstart page highlights common task routing for feature work, bug fixes, deployment and ops changes, auth and access changes, and data or domain changes.
The quickstart page gives practical source entrypoints for backend request handling, resolver composition, assistant and free-text transaction flows, SPA bootstrap, and CDK stack wiring.
The quickstart page contains a compact Mermaid navigation map that links the wiki entry point to the major topical pages and keeps the map task-oriented rather than mirroring the repository tree.
